lines.text: In two thousand and one, Delhi was gripped by a terrifying urban legend,
where people were terrified to sleep on their own rooftops.
It was a sweltering May, and everyone was whispering about the Monkey Man.
Witnesses described a four foot beast with glowing red eyes,
leaping between buildings in the pitch dark.
Police switchboards exploded with hundreds of frantic emergency calls,
as terrified families huddled together under streetlights.
Dozens were injured, and two people tragically died in the panic.
Yet the mysterious creature was never captured,
and police concluded the sightings were driven entirely by mass hysteria.
Was it a real attacker, an urban myth, or India's biggest mass panic?
